Whether you’re dating, building something new, or keeping a long love alive, the skills underneath are the same.

### Love has a much messier learning curve than most things we get good at.
We develop skills in work, health, and sport through learning, practice, and feedback. Love is usually left to experience.
WeDeepen gives you a place to build the skill of love deliberately, including learning to tell the difference between:
Chemistry
versus
alignment
A rough patch
versus
a repeating pattern
Healthy compromise
versus
losing yourself
A real concern
versus
an old fear getting triggered

### Build the skills that make love easier to navigate.
-
01
Choose relationships that fit the life you actually want.
-
02
Recognize patterns before you repeat them with someone new.
-
03
Get clearer on where you stand and what you want.
-
04
Speak up sooner about needs, boundaries, and expectations.
-
05
Have hard conversations without losing the connection.
-
06
Repair conflict before hurt turns into distance.
-
07
Keep intimacy, attraction, and play alive over time.
-
08
Build trust that can handle change, mistakes, and uncertainty.

### What’s included in your membership

#### Weekly live sessions
Every Tuesday at 7pm ET. A rotating mix of ways to learn, practice, and integrate.
- Love Masterminds built around real relationship questions and situations.
- Sessions with professionals across dating, intimacy, communication, and relationships.
- Bonding exercises with other members.
- Integration Sessions to unpack what you’re learning and experiencing.

#### Private member community
A place to keep the conversation going between sessions.
- Ask the Experts Q&A with WeDeepen’s relationship professionals.
- Private discussions inside Circle.
- Bring up dating, sex, intimacy, conflict, attraction, or anything else you’re working through.
- Connect with members, compare perspectives, and share useful resources.

#### Weekly practice + recordings
Ways to stay involved even when you’re outside a session.
- A new Sunday Dare delivered by text and email each week.
- Playful social and connection challenges to try in real life.
- Recordings of every Love Mastermind from the time you join forward.
- Access to the membership calendar so you can see what’s coming up.

Core framework

### The Four Pillars of a Conscious Relationship
The core framework we live by, across WeDeepen, Love Immersion, and Love Club.
1

#### Prioritize Growth
No attachment to outcome. Growth comes first.
2

#### Own Your Own Sh*t
Take responsibility for your wounds and reactions.
3

#### All Feelings Are Welcome
No internal process is condemned.
4

#### Practice Love
In every moment, with every person.

## About WeDeepen & Founder Christina Weber

URL: https://wedeepen.com/about/

About WeDeepen

## Good at everything. Except this.
You built a career, a life, a body you take care of. Love is the one thing no one trained you for. WeDeepen is where accomplished people finally learn it, with world-class faculty and a community doing the same.
WeDeepen was founded by Christina Weber, who has produced dating, relationship, and intimacy events since 2014 (starting with Underground Unattached in New York City), reaching more than 40,000 people. She hosts the Mastering Love podcast, formerly Deepen with Christina.
Founder · CEO

### Christina Weber
Christina Weber is the founder of WeDeepen and a relationship coach who has spent more than a decade studying what makes love work.
Her gift is bringing together exceptional people, ideas, and experiences. Since producing her first dating event in New York City in 2014, Christina has curated and produced dating, relationship, and intimacy events and festivals reaching more than 40,000 people, while building a network of leading voices across relationships, intimacy, personal development, and human connection.
She is an ICF-certified coach trained at iPEC and the host of Mastering Love with Christina Weber , with more than 180 episodes exploring how we become better at love. Her work has appeared on the cover of LA Magazine , Peacock’s Ex-Rated with Andy Cohen, Real Time with Bill Maher , and on stages and at institutions including Omega Institute.
Before WeDeepen, Christina built a career in sales and entrepreneurship and brought her talent for gathering people to philanthropy. Her initiative Feminine Weapon has raised more than $100,000 for children experiencing abuse, poverty, and trafficking.
Today, through WeDeepen, Christina is bringing together the teachers, practices, experiences, and community she believes can change the way we learn love.
Her premise is simple: Love is a skill. We can get extraordinarily good at it.
Managing Partner

### René Besson
For more than thirty years, René Besson produced film and television across independent and studio environments, with credits including The Expendables , The Mechanic , Stone , Righteous Kill , Trespass , Ordinary Love , and Driven , working with talent including Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Nicole Kidman, Liam Neeson, Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, and Michael Caine.
Producing taught René how to see the whole system: people, resources, timing, emotion, and execution, and get them moving in the same direction.
He first came to WeDeepen as an advisor, helping Christina think about how to tell its story. René often returned to Roger Ebert’s description of movies as “a machine that generates empathy.” One day, Christina offered a reframe: Replace “movies” with “WeDeepen.”
It clicked.
Film lets us experience another person’s perspective through observation. René saw that WeDeepen could create empathy through participation, giving people a place to meet, be vulnerable, practice something new, and build relationships that continue beyond the experience.
He came in to help tell the story of WeDeepen. He found himself becoming part of his next big one.
Today, René works alongside Christina to turn the vision into an executable system, leading strategy, operations, business development, partnerships, storytelling, and fundraising support.

### How WeDeepen Began
It started in 2014, in New York City. Christina was hosting Underground Unattached , gathering smart, accomplished single people in one room, believing that proximity plus quality would lead to love.
For two years she watched. The right people were in the room. But the room wasn’t enough.
Pressure. Expectations. The nervous energy people walked in with. Christina began to realize that finding the right person was only part of the equation. People also needed to learn how to create and sustain great relationships.
Then couples started showing up asking: What about us?
Christina went looking for answers and discovered an entire industry dedicated to love as a learnable skill: relationship educators, coaches, therapists, researchers, somatic practitioners, intimacy teachers, and frameworks most people never knew existed.
She went deep. Got trained. Studied with the best. And eventually asked the question that would become WeDeepen:
Why isn’t there one trusted place that brings the best of this together?
So she built it.
Today, WeDeepen is a curated ecosystem for relationship education and human connection. More than 40,000 people have participated in the experiences Christina began creating over a decade ago.
The premise remains simple:
Love is a skill. You can study it. Practice it. And become extraordinary at it.
The backstory, straight from Christina

### WeDeepen with GUIDANCE
Eight values that shape how we show up: with each other, with our members, and with ourselves.

#### G rowth comes first
You believe in feeling a sense of purpose, and that purpose is growth. Individual growth. Collective growth. The kind of growth that makes the world a better place.

#### U noffendable
Anger is extraordinarily easy. It's our default setting. Love is challenging. Love is a miracle. You grow in love.

#### I ntuitive flow
When operating from the soul level, you flow.

#### D esire to receive for the sake of sharing
There is no enjoying the possession of anything valuable unless you have ones to share it with. You give to enjoy the shared life.

#### A ccepts change
Progress is impossible without change, and those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything. You can change.

#### N urture, self-discovery & freewill
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom. You trust your life journey and the lessons it's teaching you. No one will care for you better than you.

#### C uriosity & thoughtful discourse
It is not our differences that divide us. It is our inability to recognize, accept and celebrate those differences. You lead with curiosity.

#### E ssentially, our wholeness depends on relationships
The quality of my life is determined by the quality of my relationships. You love thy neighbor.

## Love Club | Private Relationship Mastermind by WeDeepen

URL: https://wedeepen.com/love-club/

Love Club

## Play Full Out.
Reminder: you are love. You were born to love. Most people never learn how to live that in relationship. You will.
Love Club is WeDeepen’s inner circle, $9,997 a year. It includes everything in the WeDeepen Membership, plus Friday Office Hours with Christina Weber, Annie Lalla’s 12-week program, Couples Council, and more.
Explore Membership
See what’s inside
Why Love Club Exists

### You optimize your health. You build wealth. You care about growth. So why does love still feel harder than it should?
You can be self-aware, emotionally intelligent, and wildly successful in every other area, and still get tangled in love. Not because you’re doing it wrong. Because love is where your nervous system, your history, your attachment patterns, and your longing all collide.
You can’t out-think that collision. You move through it with insight, reflection, and real relational practice, supported by people who can see what you can’t.
The best relationships aren’t accidents. They’re trained for.
Like athletes preparing for greatness, the people who thrive in love study, practice, and refine their skills with support. Love Club is that training ground: the arena where you focus on your love life with the same intention you bring to everything else that matters.
The Science of Desire

### When are you most drawn to your partner? The answer is also how you experience love with yourself.
Esther Perel asked thousands of people. The pattern is strikingly consistent, and it maps directly to self-love. Love Club is designed around all six truths.
Desire for your partner

##### When you’re apart and reunite
Never too close, never too far. Distance restores imagination. You miss them, and desire floods back.

##### When you see them radiant and confident
On stage, in their element, lit up by something. You see them through new eyes. Attraction reignites.

##### When you complete something together
A shared project. A challenge faced as a team. Co-creation deepens the bond beyond familiarity.
The self-love parallel

##### When you forget who you are, and remember
You lose yourself in the noise of life. Then a quiet moment brings you home. You fall back in love with yourself.

##### When you overcome an obstacle
You expand your range, face a fear, accomplish something that stretches you. You see yourself with in a new way.

##### When you create with others
Being in community. Making things happen together. Contributing to something larger than yourself. This is Love Club.
The Science Underneath

### Your nervous system has a range. Love Club expands it.
A bandwidth for how much pleasure, intimacy, connection, and aliveness you can hold. Most of us operate at a narrow slice of ours, not because we’re broken, but because no one ever stretched it.
The old thinking
“Magic happens outside your comfort zone.”
A dated view. It implies you have to leave yourself behind to grow.
The Love Club view
Magic happens when you expand your range.
You don’t leave your comfort zone. You widen it. Your nervous system learns to hold more pleasure, more truth, more intimacy. Nothing is left behind; everything is expanded.

Who It’s For

### Three audiences. One shared truth: you want more.

#### The Long-Term Couple
“We love each other. But something’s missing.”
Together 5–25 years. Stable, but stagnant. You’ve lost the spark, the novelty, the charge. You’re scared you’re becoming roommates, or strangers. Date nights aren’t enough. You need something that actually expands the relationship.

#### The Sapiosexual
“I need my mind seduced before my body follows.”
Intellectually hungry. Drawn to depth, edge, conversation that makes you think. You’re already in the personal-growth world but haven’t found a space that goes deep on love and the erotic. You read Esther Perel. You listen to podcasts. You want the embodied version.

#### The Awakened Solo
“I’m done with surface-level dating.”
Sick of apps. Sick of small talk. You want to understand your own desire, attachment, and erotic identity before choosing a partner. You want a network with depth, not another industry event disguised as connection.
Positioning

### What Love Club is, and isn’t.
Love Club is
- → An expansion of your range
- → A place where the erotic is welcomed
- → For people who crave intellectual depth and embodied experience
- → A curated network led by the world’s most daring practitioners
- → Safe enough to be dangerous
Love Club is not
- &times; Another coaching platform with affirmations
- &times; Therapy-lite or a support group
- &times; A dating service or matchmaking platform
- &times; Content you could find on a podcast
- &times; For people who want to stay small

Healing, upward spiraling and a guided journey to greater aliveness.

#### Integration & Community
Reflection, graduation, and support beyond the weekend.
Sign Me Up

### Three days to meet the parts of you that emerge when love gets real.
Most of us reach adulthood with years of education and almost none in love. We inherit a few examples, follow chemistry, learn through heartbreak, and hope experience eventually becomes wisdom.
The Love Immersion Mastermind makes that learning intentional.
At the center are the Masterminding Love hot seats. You bring what’s most alive in your love life to two expert coaches, who help you uncover what’s really happening, see the patterns at play, and move forward with greater clarity and skill.
Then you learn again by witnessing everyone else take their turn. Their questions, blind spots, breakthroughs, and courage reveal things you may not have been able to see in your own life.
Beyond the hot seats, the weekend unfolds through teachings, embodied practice, play, shared meals, deeply honest conversations, and a beautiful guided plant ceremony that opens into expanded awareness. You leave with practical ways to communicate and repair, a deeper understanding of yourself in love, and people who genuinely care what happens next.
Love can keep some of its mystery, but you don’t have to remain a mystery to yourself.

Yes, I’m In
Like language, love deepens through attention, practice, and being around people who speak it well.

### Spend three days with those equally committed to loving and being loved better.

### Three stages of learning to love.
A guarded heart doesn’t open because the mind wants it to. It opens when it feels safe enough to do so.
Love Immersion guides you from Innocent, when you trusted love without question, through Armored, when hurt taught you to protect your heart, and into Skilled, where you reclaim vulnerability, apply wisdom, and deepen self-awareness.
You move through one stage per day.
Day 1 · Saturday · Remembering

#### Innocence
The Immersion begins at 9am. Come wearing a favorite accessory or piece of clothing. Settle into the mountaintop estate, share a welcome breakfast and gather for an opening circle of introductions, intentions, agreements and novel surprises.
You’ll laugh, have fun, get a feel for the people around you, and let the joy of our newfound togetherness come naturally before the deeper work begins.
Today you begin masterminding love. Each individual or couple receives a focused 30-45 minute hot-seat session, while the rest of the group listens for the fears, needs, and protective strategies that echo through their own relationships.
Connecting with innocence here means recovering the willingness to meet another person openly, with everything life has taught you still intact.
What Saturday unlocks:
- ✓ A clearer awareness of how quickly past experiences shape new connections
- ✓ More freedom to be present without performing, impressing, or overthinking
- ✓ Renewed access to curiosity, play, and the openness that makes intimacy feel so alive
Day 2 · Sunday · Releasing

#### De-Armoring
You continue masterminding love. It’ll seem less abstract. You see how control can disguise fear, how independence can become distance, and how the desire to be chosen can lead someone away from what they truly want. What is difficult to recognize in yourself often becomes unmistakable when witnessed in another.
You’ll also find plenty of laughter, play, and unexpected moments that remind you how good it feels to be fully alive. Between the insight and the fun, people often find themselves seeing love and their own lives from an elevated perspective.
The evening moves into a guided beautiful plant ceremony, giving the two days of insights somewhere deeper to land. It’s an amazing and inspiring environment for softening around what you’ve been protecting, feeling what matters more clearly, and leaving with a stronger sense of what you want to carry into your relationships.
What Sunday unlocks:
- ✓ Greater awareness of the hidden defenses influencing who you choose and how you connect
- ✓ A higher capacity to remain open and choose consciously when old fears are activated
- ✓ Practical tools for communicating clearly, repairing conflict, and asking for what you need
Day 3 · Monday · Becoming

#### Skilled Love
Monday starts slower with a late breakfast. You’ll return to teachings, embodied practice, reflection, and a closing ceremony. By now, the patterns are easier to see, and the focus becomes what you want to do differently when they appear again.
A light and fun graduation ceremony puts a bow on the whole experience as you shape the conversations, requests, boundaries, repairs, and choices that will carry more love and grace into your relationships.
You’ll write a love letter to someone who matters to you, which we’ll mail after the Immersion, receive your graduation gift, revisit the moments that mattered, and leave around 2:00 PM.
What Monday unlocks:
- ✓ Greater confidence making relationship decisions from clarity rather than fear or habit
- ✓ Time to reflect, name what changed, and decide how to bring that into your daily life
- ✓ People who will remember what opened in you and help you keep choosing it
Sign Me Up

### Who Love Immersion Is For?
Anyone who understands that something as important as love deserves more than instinct, chemistry, and good intentions.
Some come to deepen a beautiful partnership. Some are standing at a crossroads. Some come with a general sense that they are failing at love. Others arrive on their own because they know the next chapter has to begin with them.

#### Anyone stepping into a new chapter
You may be healing from heartbreak, deciding whether to stay or leave, or preparing to love differently next time. You can arrive without a partner and make this chapter entirely your own. Many have.

#### Couples ready to go deeper
Your relationship may be anywhere on the spectrum from thriving to strained, but you want to understand each other more clearly, repair without keeping score, or nurture the connection into something even deeper, freer, and more alive.

#### High achievers ready to give love their full attention
You know how to seek expertise, do the work, and grow. Love is the one place you have mostly relied on instinct and lessons learned the hard way. You are ready to meet it with the same intention you bring to everything else.
Reserve My Spot

### The relationships you build here are the other half of the curriculum.
You may arrive among strangers or familiar faces, but never random ones. Everyone has chosen to invest in becoming better at love. With the pressure to impress or pursue removed, Love Immersion becomes a place where people can relax and be themselves.
Individuals and couples learn side by side. You watch people name what they want, own what they’ve avoided, and stay connected through interactions usually hidden behind closed doors. Again and again, someone else’s honesty makes something in your own life easier to see.
By the time you leave, these aren’t just people who attended the same retreat. You’ve laughed with them, maybe cried with them, and moved past barriers with them. They have seen what you carried in, what opened up, and how you want to live from here on. Many become trusted friends, mentors, collaborators, matchmakers, and lifelong allies as your love story continues to unfold.

### Know Before You Go
Love Immersion is WeDeepen’s 3-day, in-person relationship retreat at HAVAN Estates in Austin, Texas. Come solo or come as a couple to study and practice love with WeDeepen faculty, including live coaching and focused hot-seat sessions. October 17–19, 2026, $2,995 per person, with payment plans available.

#### Schedule, Food & Weather
- ✓ Friday, October 16 · check-in begins at 4pm for guests staying at HAVAN
- ✓ Friday evening (optional) · welcome dinner 6 to 9pm with Bootsy Greenwood on reality transurfing
- ✓ Saturday, October 17 · begins 9am with a welcome breakfast, opening circle & first hot seats
- ✓ Sunday, October 18 · a full day of masterminding, with a guided beautiful plant ceremony in the evening
- ✓ Monday, October 19 · late breakfast, closing & graduation ceremony, departures around 2pm
- ✓ All meals and drinks are included
- ✓ Austin is gorgeous in October: highs around 78–85&deg;F, evenings 58–66&deg;F

- ✓ Fly into Austin-Bergstrom (AUS), about 25 mi / 37 min from the venue
- ✓ 14 rooms available on-site to book, limited and added at checkout
- ✓ Nearby hotels: Hampton Inn & Suites Austin-Lakeway (10 min), La Quinta Inn & Suites Lakeway (10 min), and Lakeway Resort & Spa (12 min)
- ✓ Plenty of local Airbnb options
- ✓ On-site parking available
- ✓ A WhatsApp group to coordinate travel, shared after you register

#### Attire & Packing
- ✓ Day 1: a favorite accessory or piece of clothing you love to wear

- ✓ Day 3: white attire, plus a towel and swimsuit for the flower bath ritual
- ✓ Swimwear for the sauna and pool
- ✓ Sneakers for exploring outdoors
- ✓ A light jacket for cooler evenings
- ✓ A journal, and we’ll have a mini one for you too

### Frequently Asked

#### The Inner Questions
Absolutely. About half of every Immersion arrives solo, each for their own reason. Some come purely for themselves. Some aren’t partnered, are open to dating, or are focused on self-love. And sometimes a partner just isn’t ready, available, or up for it yet.
That’s completely okay. Come by yourself rather than not coming at all: the work meets you exactly where your love life is.
No. A romantic partner is a beautiful way to experience the Immersion, but far from the only one. We’ve welcomed siblings, close friends, and parent and child, because love is bigger than romance.
The skills you build here strengthen every relationship that matters to you. Come with whoever you want to love better, or come for the relationship you have with yourself.
Love reaches places that self-awareness alone may never touch. You can understand your history, recognize your patterns, and feel grounded on your own. Then closeness brings something older to the surface, like the fear of being rejected, abandoned, controlled, or not fully chosen.
Love Immersion lets you meet those moments as they happen, with skilled guidance and other people reflecting what is difficult to see from inside your own experience. The deeper work is not learning more about yourself. It is learning how to remain yourself when love asks the most of you.
We’re understanding of that. This is a very vulnerable experience for anyone, and you won’t be asked to manufacture vulnerability beyond what you’re comfortable with.
The weekend begins with shared meals, play, conversation, and smaller experiences that allow trust to develop naturally. You still decide what you bring to your hot seat and how deeply you want to go. The experience is also guided by clear agreements around confidentiality, respect, and no unsolicited coaching.
Many people arrive a bit guarded. Watching others go first gives them permission to open in their own time.
It’s one of the most special, raved-about experiences of the entire Immersion. By ceremony night you’ve been through the hot seats and witnessed everyone else’s, so you know each other in ways rarely experienced in other social circles. This is where we go even deeper.
The evening weaves together breathwork, visioning, shared intention setting, and play: spontaneous, improvisational, and alive with the magic of human connection. It’s where old social wounds soften and your new skills get their first real practice. And yes, Christina always brings out her Truth or Dare.
After you register, you’ll receive a link to an intake form where you can apply to receive the beautiful plant that evening. From there we’ll talk with you about the type of plant and the finer details of the ceremony. We follow the MAPS protocol, and our facilitators are highly trained.
“The ceremony night and the group release activity… coming up on the medicine during that was incredible. Felt like I was channeling.” – Immersion Participant
Nope. The ceremony will be heart-opening whether you choose to add the plant or not. And you don’t need to decide before you get here; you’ll just need to complete the intake form. Some people come unsure and feel it out upon arrival.
For safety, medications are reviewed beforehand and trained support is present throughout. But please know there is absolutely no pressure to do what the others are doing for the sake of fitting in. You’ll be encouraged to be you through the entire experience.

#### The Outer Details
Participants have ranged from eighteen to eighty-seven, with the sweet spot in the thirties through sixties. We’ve welcomed couples who recently fell in love, people moving through divorce, siblings, and even parent and child.
Love is for everybody, and it’s a skill to master. Whatever your age or chapter, there is always something more, and a new layer ready to reveal itself.
Very carefully. Christina has worked in the love, dating, and relationship industry for over fifteen years, and the coaches chosen for Love Immersion are senior leaders in their field: her own mentors, and the very people she calls for guidance in her own love life.
They are masters of their craft. Working with them privately typically ranges from $5,000 to $10,000 and up per month. At Love Immersion, they are in the room with you all weekend.
And we are always open to connecting with other brilliant coaches. If there is someone you think we should know, send us a note .
Of course. If you work in the love and relationship industry, or you’re endlessly curious about it, this is your place. There’s no hierarchy here: you’ll fit right in.
Many love coaches join us for exactly this reason. You spend your life supporting others. This is where you receive that same full attention from top coaches, and build real friendships and rapport with us while you’re at it. We can’t wait to have you.
This is a full-on immersion: plan nothing else for these three days. We want all of your attention with us, and you’ll want all of the experience.

Meals and breathing room are woven through each day, and when we rest, you’ll want to rest too.
You can, but you don’t have to, and you’ll get the full experience either way. The WeDeepen team producing Love Immersion stays on-site, and we love it when you join us there. The name says it: you really immerse.
Lodging is booked separately, and you have options. Reserve a private room or a bed in the men’s or women’s dorm during checkout, book a nearby hotel or Airbnb, or commute in if you’re an Austin local. We share recommendations when you register, and parking is easy.
And one night is special: on Sunday’s ceremony night, everyone is welcome to stay over in the common space, whether you’ve booked lodging with us or not. There will be plenty of sleeping areas. Just bring a cosmetic bag and a change of clothes for the next day, and you’ll be well taken care of.
Yes. There is a payment plan you can choose at checkout when you purchase your ticket. And if you need something more customized, we can most likely accommodate you. Send us a quick note at team@wedeepen.com and we’ll do whatever we can to support you getting here.
You’ll receive a confirmation email with a link to join our private, participants-only WhatsApp group, along with your ceremony intake form, your Love Immersion handbook, and details on how to prepare for the event.
Come into the WhatsApp group and introduce yourself. We’re so excited to have you join us.
First off, amazing. Redeeming your Immersion credit is one of the best parts of being in the club, and we absolutely want you here.
We’ve set up a special promo code for members to use at checkout. If you have any trouble, message Roxy Ruse, our community manager and events coordinator, at team@wedeepen.com.
Most likely not. After seven Immersions, we have a devoted crew who show up again and again, and they get first access to volunteer spots. If you’d like to explore whether any are available, reach out to team@wedeepen.com. Just know these are reduced-rate positions rather than free ones.
Tickets are non-refundable, but they are fully transferable: if life redirects you, your spot can become someone else’s beginning. Write to team@wedeepen.com and we’ll help you make the handoff.

## Relationship Experts & Love Coaches | WeDeepen Faculty

## Meet the Faculty.
No one teacher. No one modality. No one path. World-class experts in love and relationships, each with a distinct specialty.
Love Strategist & Founder

### Christina Weber
Love Industry Pioneer · Speaker · Experience Designer · Coach
Founder of WeDeepen. Christina began her career hosting Underground Unattached dating events in NYC in 2014, and after recognizing that proximity alone couldn't teach people to love well, she went deep into the underground world of relationship education. Over a decade later, she's curated the most potent experiences in the love industry into one ecosystem.
ICF Certified Coach · iPEC Trained · Heart-Coaching Certified. Based in Austin, TX.
@christinaweber
christinalweber.com
Cartographer of Love

### Annie Lalla
Philosopher, relationship coach, and self-described Cartographer of Love, Annie has spent decades mapping the architecture of great relationships. Her frameworks for conflict, commitment, and communication are used by some of the world's most successful couples.
Expect intelligence, warmth, and a linguistic precision that reorganizes how you understand your own love life.
@annielalla
annielalla.com
Author of Deeper Dating

### Ken Page, LCSW
Psychotherapist, bestselling author of Deeper Dating , and host of the Deeper Dating Podcast, Ken has spent four decades guiding people back to what he calls their Core Gifts : the places of deepest sensitivity that hold the keys to lasting intimacy.
His work has been featured in O, The Oprah Magazine , The New York Times , and Cosmopolitan , and has helped thousands trade the games of seduction for the slower, truer pull of real connection.
@deeper.dating
deeperdatingpodcast.com
Deep Transformation & Clarity

### Ariana Hall
Ariana works in the precise territory between truth and tenderness. Her coaching cuts through the stories people have been telling themselves for years, and holds them steady while they feel what was underneath.
Known for clarity without cruelty, Ariana is the strategist you go to when you're ready to stop dressing up the same pattern in new clothes.
@arianahall
arianahall.com
Intimacy & Embodied Partnership

### Yossef Sagi
Yossef brings the ancient and the anatomical together: intimacy as a practice of presence, nervous system regulation, and deep somatic attunement.
A Master Coach and longtime student of both Kabbalah and Tantra, Yossef is known for creating containers where people drop the armor they didn't know they were wearing.
@yossefsagi
yossefsagi.com
Feminine Embodiment

### Dana Arielle
Dana's work lives at the intersection of feminine embodiment, pleasure, and devotion. She teaches women (and anyone returning to their feminine) how to move from performance into presence, from ambition into receptivity, without losing edge.
A practitioner of sacred movement, erotic self-awareness, and nervous system softening. Her presence alone is the transmission.
danaarielle.com
Radical Play & Polarity

Jordan teaches the embodied mechanics of polarity, the magnetic tension between masculine and feminine energy that keeps long-term relationships alive. His work invites radical play, presence, and the kind of permission most people have never been given to desire fully.

## The 4 Pillars of a Conscious Relationship | WeDeepen

URL: https://wedeepen.com/four-pillars/

Core Framework

## The Four Pillars of a Conscious Relationship
Relationships are going through a redesign. The old paradigm isn’t working: people are unsatisfied in love and don’t know how to make it work. That breakdown isn’t bad news. When systems break down, they change, and what is emerging is conscious love.
So what is a conscious relationship? A romantic relationship with a purpose, and that purpose is growth. Your growth. Growth as a couple. Growth that makes the world better.
Most people get into relationships to meet their own needs. That works for a while, then it fails. When two people come together with the intention of growth, the partnership becomes a path of evolution, and deep, long-term fulfillment follows. These four pillars are what that looks like in practice.
1

### Prioritize growth.
The conscious couple is not attached to the outcome of the relationship. Growth comes first.
Not being attached to the outcome doesn’t mean you don’t care what happens, or that you have no picture of how it might turn out. It means you are more committed to growing than to making the relationship “work.”
We are here to grow: physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually. When growth stops, something feels wrong, because it is. Most relationships stifle growth rather than feed it. We shrink to please each other, and the relationship starts to feel like a cage. The truth is, we caged ourselves.
The conscious couple values growth above everything else, even at the risk of outgrowing the relationship. That risk is exactly what keeps it alive.
2

### Own your own sh*t.
Each person is committed to taking responsibility for their wounds, reactions, and patterns.
Everyone carries wounds from the past, and closeness will trigger them. The conscious couple expects to feel abandoned, trapped, rejected, or overlooked at some point, and doesn’t treat that as proof something has gone terribly wrong.
Those feelings come from our own patterning and limiting beliefs, not from our partner. Dysfunctional patterns dissolve only when we take responsibility for them first. Blame keeps you stuck. Ownership sets you free.
3

### All feelings are welcome.
No internal process is condemned.
In a conscious relationship there is room to feel anything, and room to say it. This is edgy territory. You may not like what you hear; it may trigger the hell out of you. You’re willing to be triggered if it means your partner gets to be real.
Most of us mold ourselves to keep the people we love from leaving. It slowly squeezes the love out of the connection. The only way through is radical honesty: revealing the parts that are hard to share, and letting your partner do the same. That is what it feels like to be known, seen, and understood.
4

### Practice love.
The relationship is a place to practice love, in every moment, with every person.
Love is a practice: of acceptance, presence, forgiveness, and stretching your heart into vulnerable territory. We tend to treat it as a destination and chase the peak feeling, then feel cheated when it fades. That misses the point.
Love is a journey. It is showing up for every nuance of the relationship and asking, What would love do here? The answer is different every time, and each answer takes you somewhere new. The conscious couple is fiercely committed to being the embodiment of love, and love shows up in their lives in ways they never imagined.
Based on the original teachings by Shelly Bullard, MFT. Adapted by Christina Weber for WeDeepen.
Love is a lifelong practice of shedding ego, armor, and control, combined with ever-increasing acts of sharing. These pillars make that possible.

# Answers

## Relationship Workshops in Austin: How to Choose One

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/relationship-workshops-austin/
Published: 2026-10-03

Short answer: Austin's relationship workshops fall into three groups: method-based couples workshops (Gottman's Art and Science of Love and Imago's Getting the Love You Want), therapist-led couples retreats, and experiential programs like WeDeepen's Love Immersion, a three-day in-person retreat open to couples and solo participants. Choose a method-based workshop for a structured protocol with your partner; choose WeDeepen to practice love with several teachers, partnered or not.

Search "relationship workshops in Austin" and you get a mix of very different things under one label. Some are clinical programs that teach one research-backed method to couples. Some are therapist-led retreats. Some are experiential weekends where you practice connection with other people in the room. They all count as workshops, but they suit different people. This guide sorts them out so you can pick the one that fits where your love life actually is.

### The main relationship workshops in Austin

#### Gottman: The Art and Science of Love
The Center for Relationships in Austin runs the Gottman Institute's two-day couples retreat, The Art and Science of Love, led by Dr. Vagdevi Meunier, a Gottman Master Trainer. The format mixes presentations with exercises each couple does privately. It rests on John and Julie Gottman's research into what separates relationships that last from ones that don't: friendship, managing conflict, and building shared meaning. Dates are listed on the Gottman Institute's event page .
Best for: committed couples who want a structured, research-based protocol and a shared vocabulary for conflict.

#### Imago: Getting the Love You Want
Imago Texas offers the Getting the Love You Want couples workshop, roughly 18 to 20 hours over two and a half days, with in-person dates in Austin and other Texas cities. It follows the Imago approach created by Dr. Harville Hendrix and Dr. Helen LaKelly Hunt, which centers on a structured dialogue that helps partners hear each other without defending.
Best for: couples stuck in the same argument who want one clear technique to practice at home.

#### Therapist-led couples retreats
Several Austin practices run their own intensives and retreats, for example Krista J Miller's couples workshops and retreats . These usually sit closer to therapy: a licensed clinician, a small number of couples, and a focus on a specific problem. Check the credentials and the method before you book.
Best for: couples who want clinical depth in a concentrated format.

#### WeDeepen Love Immersion
Love Immersion is WeDeepen's three-day, in-person retreat in Austin. It looks different from the clinical options: live "hot seat" coaching where people work on what they actually came with, connection exercises that land in the body rather than the head, and long stretches of unstructured time with the other participants. It isn't built on one method. The faculty are senior teachers from different traditions, chosen by founder Christina Weber. About half of every Love Immersion arrives solo, and participants have ranged from 18 to 87. It costs $2,995 per person, with a payment plan at checkout.
Best for: anyone, partnered or not, who wants to study love with several teachers and practice it with real people.

#### WeDeepen Membership (online, every week)
If a weekend feels like too big a first step, the WeDeepen Membership runs a 90-minute live session every Tuesday at 6:00 PM Central, alternating Love Masterminds with guest experts and Integration Sessions where you practice what you learned. It includes a private community and a weekly Sunday Dare. It's $99 a month, and you can cancel anytime.

### How the options compare
Option Format Partner needed? Approach
Gottman Art and Science of Love 2-day couples workshop Yes One research-based method
Imago Getting the Love You Want About 2.5 days, couples Yes Structured dialogue
Therapist-led retreats Varies; small groups or private Usually Clinical
WeDeepen Love Immersion 3-day in-person retreat in Austin No; about half come solo Multiple teachers, live coaching, practice
WeDeepen Membership Weekly live online sessions plus community No Ongoing practice with rotating experts

### How to choose
Start with three questions.
- Are you coming as a couple? Gottman and Imago workshops are designed for two partners working together. If you're single, dating, or your partner isn't ready, choose a format that welcomes you on your own.
- Do you want one method or many? A single method gives you a clean toolkit. Several teachers give you range, and you keep what works for you.
- Do you want to learn about love or practice it? Some workshops mostly teach. Others put you in live exercises with other people. Both have value; know which one you're signing up for.

### Workshop or therapy?
A relationship workshop is education. It teaches skills and gives you a place to practice them. It is not a substitute for therapy. If you're dealing with abuse, addiction, or a mental-health crisis, start with a licensed clinician. Many couples do both: therapy for the hard history, a workshop for new skills and fresh air.

### Where WeDeepen fits
WeDeepen starts from a simple premise: love is a trainable skill. You don't need a crisis, a breakup, or a partner to get better at it. Every WeDeepen experience runs on the Four Pillars : growth comes first, with no attachment to outcome; you own your own experience; all feelings are welcome; and the relationship is a place to practice love. Read what past participants say , check the events calendar , or join the membership and start this Tuesday. Come play with us.

### FAQ

#### Do I need a partner to attend a relationship workshop in Austin?
For Gottman and Imago couples workshops, yes. WeDeepen's Love Immersion and Membership welcome individuals, and about half of every Love Immersion arrives solo.

#### How long are relationship workshops?
Most run two to three days. The Gottman Art and Science of Love is two days, Imago's Getting the Love You Want is about two and a half, and WeDeepen's Love Immersion is three full days in Austin. WeDeepen's Membership meets weekly online.

#### Is a relationship workshop the same as couples therapy?
No. A workshop teaches skills to a group; therapy treats a specific couple's situation with a licensed clinician. WeDeepen is relationship education and coaching, not therapy.

#### What happens at a WeDeepen Love Immersion?
Three days of live coaching, connection exercises, teaching from several faculty members, and unstructured time with the group, at a private venue in Austin. You can come alone, with a partner, a friend, or a family member.

Yes. The WeDeepen Membership is $99 a month for a live online session every Tuesday plus a private community, and you can cancel anytime.

## The Best Ways to Meet People in Austin

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/best-ways-to-meet-people-austin/
Published: 2026-10-03

Short answer: The best ways to meet people in Austin put you in the same room with the same people more than once: recreational leagues like Austin Sports & Social Club, run clubs, Meetup groups, volunteering, hosted dinners like Timeleft, and connection-focused communities like WeDeepen, which runs weekly sessions and in-person Austin events. Repetition and shared activity matter more than the venue.

Austin is full of people who moved here recently, work from home, and still haven't found their people. The city has plenty to do. What's harder to find is the thing that actually builds connection: seeing the same faces again and again, doing something together, and having at least one real conversation. Here are the ways that work, and how to choose between them.

### Why repetition beats one-off events
A single mixer rarely turns into a relationship of any kind. Research by University of Kansas professor Jeffrey Hall found it takes roughly 50 hours together to go from acquaintance to casual friend, and more than 200 hours to become close friends. So the best way to meet people isn't the most exciting event in town. It's the one you'll keep going back to.

### The best ways to meet people in Austin

#### Recreational sports leagues
Austin Sports & Social Club runs coed adult leagues across about ten sports, including volleyball, soccer, kickball, and pickleball, with a happy hour after games. A season gives you a built-in team and a weekly reason to show up. You don't need to be good, just willing.

#### Run clubs
Austin's run clubs are some of the most social in the country. Austin Runners Club lists weekly training and social runs, and Austin Fit Magazine's run club roundup covers the central-city groups where the post-run hang matters as much as the miles.

#### Meetup groups
Meetup's Austin social groups cover everything from board games to hiking to groups made for newcomers. Choose a small group that meets often over a large one that meets rarely.

#### Volunteering
United Way for Greater Austin's Hands On Central Texas program has long connected Austin volunteers with local projects. Volunteering gives you a shared purpose and a natural conversation starter, and recurring shifts put you next to the same people week after week.

#### Dinners with strangers
Timeleft matches you with a small group for a weekly dinner at a local restaurant, based on a personality questionnaire. Time Out tried it in Austin . It's a low-pressure way to practice talking to new people.

#### City classes
Austin Parks and Recreation community centers offer adult classes from arts and crafts to pickleball. A class has a built-in schedule and a shared beginner's awkwardness, which helps.

#### Connection-focused communities: WeDeepen
Most options above build connection as a side effect of an activity. WeDeepen makes connection the point. The Austin-based relationship education company runs a weekly live online session every Tuesday at 6:00 PM Central, a private member community, in-person events in Austin , and the three-day Love Immersion retreat. The conversations go past small talk on purpose: dating, partnership, desire, conflict, and what you actually want. Members are partnered, dating, between relationships, or just curious. About half of every Love Immersion arrives solo.

### How to make it stick
- Commit to three visits. The first time is always awkward. By the third, people recognize you.
- Pick one recurring thing, then add one. Two regular commitments beat ten one-off events.
- Ask a real question. "What brought you to Austin?" opens more than "What do you do?"
- Make the second plan yourself. Suggest coffee or the next event. Most people are waiting for someone else to ask.
- Notice what you bring. If you hold back to avoid looking eager, you're shrinking. Connection rewards the person who shows up fully.

### Where WeDeepen fits
WeDeepen treats connection the way a gym treats strength: love is a trainable skill, and you get better by practicing with other people. Sessions run on the Four Pillars , so all feelings are welcome and you own your own experience. WeDeepen's view is that community is your third place: not home, not work, somewhere you're known. Start with the $99 monthly membership , come to an in-person event, and see who you meet. Come play with us.

Making friends as an adult in Austin has a specific shape. Many people here are transplants, plenty work remotely, and the friends from school or your last city are a flight away. None of that means something is wrong with you. Adult friendship just doesn't happen by accident the way it did at school, so you have to build the conditions for it on purpose.

### Friendship takes time, so plan for it
University of Kansas researcher Jeffrey Hall estimated the hours it takes : about 50 hours together to go from acquaintance to casual friend, about 90 to become friends, and more than 200 to become close friends. You won't get there through one happy hour. You get there by putting yourself somewhere you'll see the same people every week.

### Where adults in Austin make friends

#### A recurring team or league
Austin Sports & Social Club runs coed adult leagues in about ten sports, with games in neighborhoods across the city and a social hour afterward. You can sign up alone and get placed on a team.

Austin Runners Club offers weekly training and social runs, and the Austin Insider running guide covers the trails and groups at the heart of the city's running scene. Runs are easy to drop into, and coffee afterward is where friendships start.

#### A Meetup group built for newcomers
Meetup's Austin social category includes groups made specifically for people new to the city or looking for friends. Smaller groups that meet weekly are where you'll start recognizing people.

#### A friendship app
Bumble For Friends works like a dating app for platonic connection. It helps you find people; turning a match into a friend still takes repeated plans in person.

#### A table of strangers
Timeleft books you into a weekly dinner with a small group matched by personality. One dinner won't make a friend, but it's good practice, and some tables keep meeting.

If small talk is what wears you out, WeDeepen is built for the conversations most groups avoid. ### From acquaintance to friend
- Be the one who invites. Most people want more friends and wait for someone else to make the plan. Make it.
- Make specific plans. "Want to get tacos after Thursday's run?" works better than "We should hang out sometime."
- Follow up within a week. Momentum matters more than polish.
- Go a level deeper. Share something true about your week, not just the highlights. Closeness grows when both people risk a little.
- Stop shrinking. If you mute yourself to seem easygoing, people meet a version of you that isn't real. Let them meet the real one.

### Friendship is a skill
WeDeepen's premise is that love is a trainable skill, and friendship is one of its purest forms. Listening without fixing, asking for what you want, repairing after a misstep: you can practice all of these. ## Alternatives to Dating Apps in Austin

Here are the main alternatives to dating apps, what each one does well, and how to choose.

### Why in-person beats the feed
Apps are good at one thing: showing you a lot of people fast. They're bad at the information that actually predicts attraction and compatibility: how someone listens, how they laugh, how they treat the server, what it feels like to sit next to them. Meeting in person gives you all of that in the first five minutes. The alternatives below trade volume for that kind of signal.

You meet people who are working on themselves, which makes them more interesting to meet.

### How to choose
- Want volume? Speed dating gives you the most new people per evening.
- Want low pressure? Dinners, leagues, and interest groups let attraction show up on its own schedule.

- Want to get better at dating itself? A community like WeDeepen builds the skills you take to every first date. Pair it with any of the options above.

Whichever route you choose, the first conversation matters. Ask questions you actually want answered, share something real, and notice how you feel around the person, not just whether they check boxes.

## Speed Dating Alternatives in Austin

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/speed-dating-alternatives-austin/
Published: 2026-10-03

Short answer: If speed dating in Austin feels too rushed, try formats with longer conversations and repeat contact: hosted dinners like Timeleft, social sports leagues, run clubs, Meetup groups, and connection-focused communities like WeDeepen, where you practice real conversation instead of eight-minute interviews. If you like the speed format, CitySwoon and Cheeky Date run regular Austin events.

Speed dating has a loyal following in Austin, and for good reason: you meet a lot of people in one evening without a single swipe. But eight minutes per person isn't for everyone. Some people freeze under the clock, and others leave with a list of names and no real sense of anyone. If that sounds familiar, here's what to try instead, and how to get more out of speed dating if you still like it.

### What speed dating does well, and where it falls short
Speed dating works because it's in person and efficient. You get the read you can't get from a profile: voice, presence, chemistry. It falls short because the format rewards quick performance over real connection. Many interesting people warm up slowly, and a short timer cuts them off before they get going. The alternatives below keep the in-person signal and give conversations more room.

### If you like the format: speed dating in Austin
CitySwoon runs matched "Speed Dating 2.0" nights at Austin venues, with phone check-in and live-selected mini-dates. Cheeky Date hosts host-led, age-bracketed events in East Austin, South Austin, and downtown. Aggregators like Event Flo list other upcoming events.

### Speed dating alternatives in Austin

Timeleft seats you with a small, personality-matched group for a weekly dinner. A whole meal gives conversation time to go somewhere. Time Out's Austin write-up describes how it works.

#### Interest groups and run clubs
Meetup groups and Austin Runners Club social runs put you side by side doing something you enjoy. That takes the pressure off and lets attraction build.

It's not a dating event, but it's a room full of open, curious people who want deeper connection, and about half of every Love Immersion arrives solo.

### How to get more from any dating event
- Skip the résumé questions. Ask what someone is excited about this month, not what they do for work.
- Notice your body. Do you feel relaxed or tense next to this person? That tells you more than their answers do.
- Say something true. A little honesty about yourself invites honesty back.
- Follow up fast. If someone interests you, suggest a specific second meeting within a few days.
- Read up. WeDeepen's guides to first date conversation and compatibility vs. chemistry help you tell a spark from a fit.

Speed dating tests you on the spot. WeDeepen trains the skill underneath. Love is a trainable skill, and the people who date well have practiced presence, curiosity, and asking for what they want. ## Dating Coach in Austin: What They Do and How to Choose

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/austin-dating-coach/
Published: 2026-10-04

Short answer: A dating coach in Austin helps you get clear on what you want, see the patterns you repeat, and practice the conversations that matter. Coaching isn't therapy and isn't matchmaking. Look for real training, such as an International Coaching Federation credential. WeDeepen founder Christina Weber, an ICF-certified coach, offers private sessions on Zoom, plus a weekly membership and Austin retreats to practice in.

A dating coach in Austin helps you get better at the part of love you can practice: how you meet people, what you notice on a first date, how you say what you want, and why the same pattern keeps showing up. This guide covers what dating coaches actually do, how they differ from therapists and matchmakers, which credentials mean something, and how WeDeepen fits if you want coaching plus a community to practice in.

### What a dating coach does
Coaching works on where you are now and where you want to go. A good dating coach helps you get clear on what you want in a partner, look honestly at the patterns you repeat, practice conversations you've been avoiding, and make decisions faster. Some coaches focus on tactics like profiles and openers. Others go deeper into attachment, self-worth, and the parts of you that show up when someone good arrives.
Christina Weber, WeDeepen's founder, works in the deeper lane. Her first question for every client is the same: how's your love life? In private sessions on Zoom , she maps how you love, decide, and connect, sometimes drawing on the Erotic Blueprints and WeDeepen's Four Pillars , and sends you off with something specific to practice. Love is a trainable skill, and coaching is the reps.

### Dating coach, therapist, or matchmaker
These three get blurred, but they do different jobs:
- A therapist is licensed to treat mental-health conditions and work through past hurt, trauma, and attachment wounds. If depression, anxiety, or trauma is driving your dating life, start there.
- A dating coach works on you: your clarity, your habits, your choices, and the skills you bring into a room. Coaching isn't therapy and doesn't replace it.
- A matchmaker runs the search for you, finding and vetting people outside your circle and setting up introductions. As one matchmaking firm puts it , a matchmaker is hired to run the search itself.
Many people benefit from more than one. WeDeepen's Love Club , for example, pairs coaching and education with Collaborative Matchmaking through partner matchmakers.

### Credentials worth checking
Anyone can call themselves a dating coach, so ask about training. The most widely recognized coaching credentials come from the International Coaching Federation . Its three levels are:
- ACC: 60+ hours of coach education and 100+ hours of coaching experience.
- PCC: 125+ hours of education and 500+ hours of experience.
- MCC: 200+ hours of education and 2,500+ hours of experience.
Christina Weber is an ICF-certified coach trained at iPEC. She has also been producing dating, relationship, and intimacy events since 2014, reaching more than 40,000 people.
Credentials aren't everything. Ask how the coach works, what a typical session looks like, and whether they'll tell you the truth when you'd rather not hear it.

### Questions to ask before you hire one
- Do you work with my situation: dating again after divorce, dating while partnered, or deciding whether to stay?
- Will my partner be able to join sessions if we start dating seriously?
- What will I practice between sessions?
- How do you know when to refer me to a therapist?
- Is there a way to keep practicing with other people, not just with you?
That last question matters more than most people expect. Coaching gives you insight. Practice with real people turns it into skill.

### How WeDeepen fits
WeDeepen is an Austin relationship education company, not a dating app. You can work with it at three depths:
- Private coaching with Christina: one-on-one or couples sessions on Zoom. A first session is $295, credited toward her Love Accelerator mentorship if you continue. Book a session .
- The WeDeepen Membership: $99/month or $990/year, with a 90-minute live session every Tuesday at 6 PM Central and a private community. It's a place to practice love every week with people who take it seriously. Join the membership .
- Love Immersion: a three-day in-person retreat in Austin at $2,995, with live hot-seat coaching from several experts. About half the participants arrive solo. See the Love Immersion page .
Coaching works best when growth comes first, with no attachment to outcome. You don't have to be in crisis, and you don't need a partner to start. Come play with us.

### FAQ

#### Is a dating coach the same as a therapist?
No. A therapist is licensed to treat mental-health conditions and past trauma. A dating coach focuses on your present choices, skills, and patterns in dating. Coaching isn't a substitute for therapy.

#### Do dating coaches in Austin work in person or online?
Both are common. Christina Weber coaches on Zoom, and WeDeepen runs in-person retreats in Austin.

#### What credential should a dating coach have?
There's no license for dating coaches. The most recognized credentials come from the International Coaching Federation (ACC, PCC, MCC), which require set hours of education and coaching experience.

#### Can couples see a dating coach?
Many coaches, including Christina Weber, work with couples as well as individuals.

#### Does WeDeepen offer matchmaking?
Love Club, WeDeepen's inner circle at $9,997/year, includes Collaborative Matchmaking with partner matchmakers. The membership itself is a place to learn and practice, not a matchmaking service.

- ICF: compare coaching credentials

## Intimacy Coach in Austin: What to Expect and How to Choose

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/intimacy-coach-austin/
Published: 2026-10-04

Short answer: An intimacy coach helps you build emotional, physical, and sexual closeness through conversation, guided exercises, and practice. It's coaching, not therapy. For sexual pain, trauma, or mental-health concerns, see a licensed sex therapist; AASECT certifies them. In Austin, WeDeepen offers private coaching with Christina Weber, a weekly online membership taught by intimacy and somatic experts, and in-person Love Immersion retreats.

An intimacy coach helps individuals and couples build closeness: emotional, physical, and sexual. Sessions are mostly conversation and practice, with exercises you take home. It's education and coaching, not therapy and not hands-on bodywork. In Austin, you'll find intimacy coaches working privately, licensed sex therapists in clinical practice, and group programs like WeDeepen's workshops and retreats. This guide explains the differences so you can choose.

### What an intimacy coach works on
Common reasons people come to an intimacy coach:
- Desire has faded in a long relationship, or you and your partner want different things.
- You struggle to say what you want, in bed or out of it.
- You feel armored, and keep people at a distance even when you want them close.
- You want to explore something new, like Tantra, kink, or opening a relationship, with guidance.
- You're dating again and want to understand your own patterns first.
A lot of the work is about the nervous system. WeDeepen faculty member Kimi Inch, a somatic therapist, put it this way on Christina Weber's podcast: "If we are struggling to keep a regulated nervous system, it's really hard for us to step into our pleasure and to be in deep connection and intimacy with another." Our guide to that episode covers how safety is built step by step.

### Intimacy coach vs. sex therapist
The difference is training and scope:
- A sex therapist is a licensed mental-health clinician. The American Association of Sexuality Educators, Counselors and Therapists (AASECT) certifies sex therapists, who need at least a master's degree in a clinical field that includes psychotherapy training, plus supervised experience. See a sex therapist for sexual pain, trauma, compulsive behavior, or anything tied to a mental-health condition.
- An intimacy coach isn't licensed to treat conditions. Coaches focus on skills, communication, and practice. Training varies widely, so ask. AASECT also certifies sexuality educators and counselors, and the International Coaching Federation credentials coaches in general.
If you're unsure, start with a consultation and ask the coach directly when they'd refer you to a therapist. A good coach will have a clear answer.

### Frameworks you may hear about
Intimacy coaches often draw on a few common maps:
- The Erotic Blueprints, created by Jaiya : five arousal types (Energetic, Sensual, Sexual, Kinky, Shapeshifter). Knowing your mix and your partner's makes it easier to meet each other.
- Somatic and embodiment work: practices that bring attention into the body so you feel what you want, not just think it.
- Tantra and conscious kink: structured, consent-based ways to explore energy, power, and play.
- Attachment-focused approaches: such as Emotionally Focused Therapy, used in Hold Me Tight workshops in Austin run by therapists.

### One-on-one coaching or a group
Private coaching gives you focus and privacy. Groups give you something private sessions can't: you learn by watching others work through what you're facing, and you practice with real people. At WeDeepen's Love Immersion retreats, participants take turns in live "hot seats" with two expert coaches, and everyone learns from each turn. All feelings are welcome, and you own your own experience: every exercise is an invitation, never a demand.
Many people do both. A few private sessions help you get clear on what you want to work on. A group then gives you a place to practice it, with feedback from people who aren't your partner and have no stake in being polite.

### Intimacy coaching at WeDeepen
WeDeepen is an Austin relationship education company built on one idea: love is a trainable skill. Options:
- Private coaching with Christina Weber, an ICF-certified coach trained at iPEC, one-on-one or as a couple on Zoom. A first session is $295. Book a session .
- The WeDeepen Membership, $99/month, with a live session every Tuesday at 6 PM Central, taught by a rotating faculty of intimacy, somatic, and relationship experts. Join the membership .
- Love Immersion, three days in person in Austin, $2,995 per person, solo or with a partner.
Meet the teachers on the faculty page . Come play with us.

### FAQ

#### Is intimacy coaching physical?
Generally no. Most intimacy coaching is conversation, guided exercises, and practices you do on your own or with a partner. Ask any coach to explain their boundaries before you book.

#### Do I need a partner to see an intimacy coach?
No. Many people work on intimacy while single, so they show up differently in their next relationship.

#### What's the difference between an intimacy coach and a sex therapist?
A sex therapist is a licensed clinician who can treat sexual and mental-health conditions. An intimacy coach focuses on skills, communication, and practice and doesn't provide therapy.

#### How do I find a certified sex therapist in Austin?
AASECT, the main certifying body in the US, certifies sex therapists, sexuality counselors, and sexuality educators.

#### Is WeDeepen therapy?
No. WeDeepen is relationship education and coaching, not a substitute for mental-health treatment.

- Jaiya: the five Erotic Blueprint types
- A New Therapy: Hold Me Tight and couples intensives in Austin

## Couples Retreats in Texas: Workshops, Intensives, Retreats

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/couples-retreat-texas/
Published: 2026-10-04

Short answer: Couples retreats in Texas come in three formats: method-based weekend workshops (Gottman, Imago, Hold Me Tight), private intensives with a licensed therapist, and experiential retreats like WeDeepen's Love Immersion in the Austin Hill Country. Choose a workshop for a shared method, an intensive for clinical depth on one problem, and Love Immersion to practice love with expert coaches, partnered or solo.

Couples retreats in Texas come in three main formats: method-based weekend workshops (Gottman, Imago, and Hold Me Tight), private intensives with a single therapist, and experiential retreats like WeDeepen's Love Immersion in the Austin Hill Country. The right one depends on whether you want a structured method, clinical depth on one problem, or a broader place to practice love. This guide walks through each so you can pick.

### Start with what you want out of it
Before comparing venues and dates, get honest about why you're going:
- You keep having the same fight. A method-based workshop gives you one shared tool and vocabulary.
- Something specific broke, like an affair, a loss, or a long freeze. A private intensive with a licensed therapist is usually the better fit.
- Nothing is wrong, but you want more. More aliveness, more honesty, more play. An experiential retreat fits here.
- Only one of you wants to go. Look for a retreat that welcomes solo participants, so the willing partner can start.

### Method-based couples workshops
These follow a published approach and are taught by trained leaders, usually over a weekend.
- Gottman, The Art and Science of Love. A two-day workshop. According to the Gottman Institute , day one covers the research and foundational skills, and day two focuses on managing conflict and communicating. It runs online and in person, including in Austin through the Center for Relationships .
- Imago, Getting the Love You Want. Imago Texas runs this workshop, about 18 to 20 hours over two and a half days, in several Texas cities. It centers on a structured dialogue.
- Hold Me Tight. Based on Dr. Sue Johnson's Emotionally Focused Therapy. Therapists offer it in Austin, for example A New Therapy , and elsewhere in Texas, such as Lifegrowth .
These are strong when both partners want to learn the same method. They're less suited to couples who want to explore beyond conflict, like desire, play, or who they each are becoming.

### Private couples intensives
A private intensive puts one couple with one therapist for a concentrated block, from a few hours to several days. A New Therapy in Austin, for example, lists three-day Emotionally Focused Therapy intensives as well as shorter sessions. These sit closest to therapy. Choose one when the stakes are high and you want clinical care. Check the therapist's license and method before you book.

### Experiential retreats
Experiential retreats are less about one method and more about practice. WeDeepen's Love Immersion is three days in person at HAVAN Estates, a private venue in the Texas Hill Country outside Austin. About 30 participants work with six coaches. The core is live hot-seat coaching: you bring what's most alive in your love life to two experts, then learn again by watching everyone else take their turn. The weekend also includes teachings, embodied practice, games, and shared meals.
Love Immersion runs on WeDeepen's Four Pillars : growth comes first, with no attachment to outcome; you own your own experience; all feelings are welcome; and the relationship is a place to practice love. It's open to couples and to people who come solo, with a friend, or with a family member. About half arrive solo. Participants rate it 9.6 out of 10, and 70% come back for another.
It's relationship education and coaching, not therapy. If you're in crisis, start with a therapist and add a retreat later.

### Questions to ask any retreat
- Who leads it, and what is their training?
- How much time is group teaching versus private work as a couple?
- Can one partner come alone?
- What happens after the weekend: is there follow-up or a community?
- What is the refund or transfer policy?
On the last point: Love Immersion tickets are $2,995 per person, with a payment plan at checkout. They're non-refundable but fully transferable.

### Keep practicing after the weekend
Every retreat leader will tell you the same thing: the weekend is the start, not the finish. Love is a trainable skill, and skills fade without practice. The WeDeepen Membership gives you a 90-minute live session every Tuesday at 6 PM Central and a private community, for $99/month. Join the membership before or after your retreat. Come play with us.

### FAQ

#### How long is a typical couples retreat in Texas?
Most run two to three days. Gottman's Art and Science of Love is two days, Imago's Getting the Love You Want is about two and a half, and Love Immersion is three.

#### Is a couples retreat the same as couples therapy?
Not always. Private intensives with a licensed therapist are therapy. Method workshops and experiential retreats like Love Immersion are education and practice.

#### Can I go to a couples retreat without my partner?
Some retreats require couples. Love Immersion welcomes solo participants, and about half arrive solo.

#### Where is Love Immersion held?
At HAVAN Estates, a private venue in the Hill Country at 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738. Meals are included; lodging is booked separately.

#### Are couples retreats in Texas held online too?
Some are. The Gottman Institute runs The Art and Science of Love as a live virtual event as well as in person.

### Sources
- The Gottman Institute: The Art and Science of Love
- Center for Relationships, Austin: Gottman couples retreats
- Imago Texas: Getting the Love You Want
- A New Therapy: Hold Me Tight and couples intensives
- Lifegrowth: Hold Me Tight workshop

## What Is a Love Immersion? WeDeepen’s Three-Day Retreat Explained

URL: https://wedeepen.com/answers/what-is-love-immersion/
Published: 2026-10-04

Short answer: Love Immersion is WeDeepen's three-day, in-person relationship retreat in Austin, Texas. About 30 participants work with six coaches through live hot-seat coaching, teachings, embodied practice, play, and shared meals. It's open to couples and solo participants, about half of whom arrive alone. It costs $2,995 per person, and it's relationship education and coaching, not therapy.

A Love Immersion is WeDeepen's three-day, in-person relationship retreat in Austin, Texas. The format is a "love mastermind": about 30 participants and six coaches, built around live hot-seat coaching, plus teachings, embodied practice, play, and shared meals. You can come solo or with a partner. This page covers what happens over the three days, who goes, what it costs, and how it differs from a workshop or therapy.

### Where the name comes from
Most of us reach adulthood with years of education and almost none in love. We follow chemistry, learn through heartbreak, and hope experience eventually turns into wisdom. Christina Weber, who founded WeDeepen, designed Love Immersion to make that learning intentional. The idea is total immersion, the way you'd learn a language: three days in which love is the only subject. The tagline for the current edition is "Mastermind your love life."

### What happens over three days
The center of the weekend is the Masterminding Love hot seat. You bring what's most alive in your love life, whether that's a decision, a pattern, a conversation you're dreading, or a desire you haven't named, to two expert coaches. They help you see what's really happening and how to move forward. Then you learn again by watching everyone else take their turn. Other people's questions, blind spots, and courage often show you things you couldn't see in your own life.
Around the hot seats, the weekend includes:
- Workshops and interactive exercises for clearer, more connected relationships.
- Play and connection: Truth or Dare, games, and surprises.
- Shared meals, all included.
- Integration and a graduation ceremony on the last day, with community support after.
The October 2026 edition, Love Immersion VIII, runs Saturday through Monday. The first day starts at 9 AM with breakfast and an opening circle, and the retreat closes around 2 PM on the third day. The full schedule is on the Love Immersion VIII page .

### Who teaches it
There's no single guru or method. The faculty are senior coaches Christina chose because they're the people she calls for guidance in her own love life. Love Immersion VIII is led by Christina Weber with Annie Lalla, Ariana Hall, Yossef Sagi, Jordan Bowditch, Rachel Cuthbert, Yarixa Ferrao, and Scott Wild. Each brings a different lens, from relationship dynamics and polarity to nervous-system healing and the one hard conversation a relationship needs. Full bios are on the faculty page .

### Who goes
- People who are dating, partnered, between relationships, or deciding whether to stay.
- About half arrive solo. Others come with a partner, a friend, a sibling, or a parent.
- Ages have ranged from 18 to 87, mostly people in their thirties through sixties.
- Relationship coaches often attend as participants.
You don't need a partner, a breakup, or a crisis to come. Participants rate it 9.6 out of 10, and 70% come back. One participant, Eva Mullen, said it this way: "I didn't think I belonged. But within a day, I felt flooded with love. I felt home." More accounts are on the reviews page .

### The rules of the room
Every Love Immersion runs on WeDeepen's Four Pillars : growth comes first, with no attachment to outcome; you own your own experience; all feelings are welcome, and no inner process is condemned; and the relationship is a place to practice love. In practice, that means you choose how far to go in any exercise, and nothing you feel is off-limits to bring.

### Cost, venue, and logistics
- Price: $2,995 per person, with a payment plan at checkout.
- Refunds: tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable.
- Venue: HAVAN Estates, a private space in the Texas Hill Country at 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738.
- Meals: included. Lodging is booked separately, with some onsite options.
- Travel: fly into Austin-Bergstrom (AUS).
Love Club members, at $9,997/year, get one Love Immersion credit, transferable to a partner.

### Between retreats
Three days can shift a lot, and love is a trainable skill, so the practice continues. The WeDeepen Membership , $99/month or $990/year, gives you a live session every Tuesday at 6 PM Central with the same faculty, and a private community. Join the membership . Come play with us.

### FAQ

#### Is Love Immersion therapy?
No. It's relationship education and coaching, not therapy or a substitute for mental-health treatment.

#### Do I need to bring a partner?
No. About half of participants come solo.

#### How many people attend?
About 30 participants, with six coaches, for Love Immersion VIII.

#### When is the next Love Immersion?
Love Immersion VIII is October 17 to 19, 2026, in Austin. Future dates are listed on the events page .

#### How is it different from a Gottman or Imago workshop?
Those teach one research-based method to couples. Love Immersion uses several coaches and live hot-seat work, and welcomes solo participants.
